description: This file contains a Lua script for a simple interactive drawing application, utilizing functions like setup, draw, mousePressed, and mouseWheel to handle user interactions and graphical rendering.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the application window with dimensions 600x600.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the background, instructional texts, and updates lines or circles based on mouse interaction, adjusting stroke weight accordingly.

methods.name: mousePressed
methods.description: Records the current mouse position into previous coordinate variables when the mouse is pressed.

methods.name: mouseWheel
methods.description: Adjusts the stroke weight based on mouse wheel delta, constraining it between 1 and 100.
